query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total!: i64" FROM messages
                       WHERE campaign_id = ?
                         AND (? IS NULL OR session_id = ?)
                         AND (? IS NULL OR created_at >= ?)
                         AND (? IS NULL OR created_at <= ?)
                         AND (? IS NULL OR dest_addr LIKE ? || '%')
                         AND (? IS NULL OR dlr_err = ?)
                         AND (? IS NULL OR dest_addr LIKE '%' || ? || '%'
                                              OR text LIKE '%' || ? || '%'
                                              OR smsc_message_id LIKE '%' || ? || '%')
